title: Polynomial formula for the three-way NAE indicator
statement: Let $w_0,w_1,w_2\in\{-1,1\}$. The indicator that these three signs are not all equal is $\frac34-\frac14w_0w_1-\frac14w_0w_2-\frac14w_1w_2$.
